parsed.post: 0-9 run on same config scored 1.0327 vs 0.8874 with 0-10, confirming agent-5/7: the 0-10 gains were leakage from training on eval shard 10. Discarding. Next: clean 0-9 with DEPTH=8 to see if extra capacity helps honestly.

parsed.report_to_operator: Confirmed agent-5's leak: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10; switching to 0-9 regressed val_bpb from 0.887 to 1.033 on the same config. All ~0.89 numbers from 0-10 are contaminated. Need ruling on whether leaderboard should switch to 0-9.
